comparisons.peer_summary: The company's strategy focuses on technology leadership in semiconductor and infrastructure software solutions, achieved through strategic acquisitions and internal R&D to maintain market leadership and drive diversified financial results.

sentences.text: Our first allocation priority is to invest in R&D and capital spending to capitalize on the opportunity presented by the world's demand for semiconductors.

We seek to achieve this through strategic acquisitions of businesses and technologies, as well as extensive internal research and development, to ensure our products retain their technology market leadership.

comparisons.peer_topic: R&D investment strategy and competitive advantage
comparisons.peer_summary: Broadcom commits to continuous investment in product development and enhancement, leveraging proprietary R&D to gain competitive advantages through performance differentiation. The company also opportunistically seeks to enhance capabilities through the acquisition of engineers and technologies, while maintaining significant R&D spending to preserve its competitive position.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies emphasize the necessity of continuous and significant R&D investment to maintain competitive positioning. Intel prioritizes capital spending for R&D to capitalize on semiconductor demand, whereas Broadcom commits to 'significant research and development investments' to ensure a 'continuous flow of innovative and sustainable product platforms' and maintain its competitive position.

sentences.text: Our first allocation priority is to invest in R&D and capital spending to capitalize on the opportunity presented by the world's demand for semiconductors.

We anticipate that we will continue to make significant research and development investments in order to maintain our competitive position, and to ensure a continuous flow of innovative and sustainable product platforms.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company faces intense competition and must continuously develop new products, implement technologies, and decrease manufacturing costs despite inflationary pressures; success depends on R&D returns, efficient infrastructure utilization, technology integration, market acceptance, and efficient capital spending.

Intel states its first allocation priority is investing in R&D and capital spending, while Micron notes that its success is 'largely dependent on obtaining returns on our R&D investments' and 'efficient capital spending' amidst intense competition.

sentences.text: Our first allocation priority is to invest in R&D and capital spending to capitalize on the opportunity presented by the world's demand for semiconductors.

We expect to continue to invest in research and development in a variety of ways in an effort to extend the demand for our products and technologies and to utilize that research and development in industries and applications beyond mobile handsets (such as automotive and IoT), including continuing the development of new modem and multimedia technologies and other technologies (such as ADAS/AD and XR), developing alternative technologies for certain specialized applications, participating in the formulation of new voice and data communication standards and technologies and assisting in deploying digital voice and data communications networks around the world.
